mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) falls by more than 2% from its 12-month high, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls > 2% from 12-month high, but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of triggered instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4%, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% YoY, but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in >40% of triggered instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4%, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both rise by more than 1% over the past 6 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy and rising inflation that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise > 1% in 6 months, but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in >40% of instances over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) fall by more than 2% from their 12-month high, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS falls > 2% from 12-month high, but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances.
